text_block_list.text:
It's a new day. I go looking for Agnes
Digital to follow up, now that
she's had
some time to think.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...You there. What are you doing, peeking
into classrooms? Trying to
observe
students in their natural habitat?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Jokes aside, circumstantial
evidence suggests that you might
just be
the "Uma simp" trainer Digital mentioned.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Is that to say you really are the one,
then? What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you're looking for her,
Digital left for
the train station. She's
probably off in
town buying Umamusume merchandise.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. That trainer really has their sights
set on Digital. She's run from plenty of
offers, but maybe... Hehe,
I'm curious what
she'll do.

I take Agnes Tachyon's tip and start
searching likely stores.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hahaaah...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Those sleek, supple leggies, framed so
elegantly... by a luscious
green turf. ♪ Or
these muscular legs, kicking up dirt with
such power...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If I was gonna pick just one photocard...
But that'd be dumb!
Obviously two is
better than one!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aaaagh, praise the heavens above! I'm so
blessed to exist in the same
timeline as all
these radiant racing goddesses!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That's it—
I was granted this time so that I
could devote it to Umas! I wasn't meant to
run alongside them, and it was selfish of
me to act so parasocial!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh, wh-who just... said that...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaagh?! F-fancy seeing you here. You
didn't, uh, happen to
overhear all that, did
you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Welp, you heard what you heard.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But I need you to know I'm dead serious! I
mean, just think about it!
Who am I?
Who?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm Agnes Digital! The biggest
Umamusume enjoyer of all
Umamusu-kind!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Do you really think I could sacrifice my
oshis?! Do you reeeally
expect me to pick
just turf or dirt?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I can't, I legit just can't, okay?! It's like telling someone to play mandolin without a pick just 'cause they can go pickless on guitar as if that's even remotely the same thing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Exactly. I'm better off watching everything on live streams than lose out 'cause I got greedy with this irl nonsense.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I remember when I was little and saw a race on TV for the first time... It blew my mind!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The fierce determination they brought to
the track. All the stories behind their
motivations!
The way it wasn't all sunshine and
rainbows...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I saw true, pure resolve. And it seized my heart!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I thought I was so lucky to be an
Umamusume myself. I thought I was
born
to run like them!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If the track is where Umas shine the
brightest, then I wanted to be there
drinking it all in and cheering them on! I
wanted to contribute
every way I could!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And I knew when I enrolled that
depending on which races I picked, 
there'd be races I couldn't watch in
person, but even so—I told myself making
that sacrifice was proof of my own
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I steeled myself and entered Tracen. But
when I took my first step on
campus...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Kyaha," "Hehehe"... Everywhere I turn,
there were Umamusume
giggling and
smiling...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
My oshis were physically right there.
I was looking at my oshis irl in
full 3D... I could
hear their breathing, their heartbeats,
their footsteps—and all in surround sound!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I finally understood... I was outside,
looking at real Umas without a
monitor
between us. And you know how I felt?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I just... I felt like my brain was gonna
EXPLODE!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
My illusions of resolve burst! Boom,
gone! I
wasn't prepared in the
slightest!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The level of detail in real life is a billion times more than a screen! And then when you consider that I've got aptitude for dirt and turf—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I can't decide! I want to run them both so
bad!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So I've made up my mind not to pick
either. That's the most I can
possibly
manage as a fan!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Got it? I'll never pick a side!
I'll never run
one if it means losing the
other!

Agnes Digital's gone full-on defensive,
and it's pretty clear she's not
going to
change her mind. But maybe...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So what's it gonna be? Can you really
afford to waste time trying to
convince
me? Shouldn't you be off helping actual
racers?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, looks like you can't argue with
that, huh? Now, leave me
alone and—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...I what?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Were you listening to any of what I
just
said? I can't even make one
entry-level
decision.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uhhh?

Thinking back, Agnes Digital had a crazy
amount of power on the dirt
track,
especially for someone her size.

And then she turned around and showed
incredibly light, precise
footwork on the
turf.

She's been putting in double the work to
hone both styles, so it'd be
a waste not to
let that effort shine!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Um... You're gonna have to run whatever
that was by me again...

It's a bit of a wild idea,
but I think I've got
a plan. I run it by her,
and...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: WHAAAAAT?!

A few days later, the whole school's abuzz
with rumors.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear the news? About Digital's
tryouts!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Of course I did! I can't believe her,
though.
I've never heard of
something like this
before.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Why is she running in both the dirt and the turf tryouts?
